items.title: Google makes Gemini 4 Carbon available to paying users and developers
items.summary: Google 喺 11 月 10 日向付費開發者、企業同 Google AI Ultra 用戶開放 Gemini 4 Carbon，定位做最強模型，主打網絡安全同長程代理工作；入門價同 Gemini 4 Argon 一樣，每百萬 input $2、output $10，11 月 30 日後改為 $4／$20。Google 亦喺 Antigravity 預覽 /swarm，可以用單一提示發動一組協調代理人。
items.imageAlt: Gemini 4 Carbon key art from the official Google blog

items.title: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini Robotics 2.5 vision-language-action model
items.summary: Google DeepMind 喺 11 月 10 日推出 Gemini Robotics 2.5，稱為迄今最強視覺語言動作模型，聲稱喺 200 多項任務上成功率較基準高 30% 至 100%，完成速度快 20% 至 30%。同 Apptronik、Mercedes-Benz 喺匈牙利同德國產線試驗中，Apollo 2 人形機械人執拾汽車零件嘅成功率報稱為 96%；模型正向機械人合作夥伴推出。
items.imageAlt: Official Google DeepMind social image for the Gemini Robotics 2.5 announcement

items.title: DeepMind introduces AlphaProof Code and says it verified Signal’s protocol implementation
items.summary: Google DeepMind 喺 11 月 10 日推出 AlphaProof Code，稱研究人員帶領由 Gemini Carbon 驅動嘅代理人，用 Lean 形式化驗證 Signal 協議實際程式碼嘅關鍵安全屬性，過程約四個星期。官方同一頁面對 Lean 證明行數有「超過六百萬行」同「超過三百萬行」兩種說法，因此具體行數未完全確定；DeepMind 亦開放相關驗證產物。
items.note: uncertain:true because the official page gives two Lean line counts: the body says over six million lines of Lean, while the og/social description says over three million lines of machine-checked proof.
items.imageAlt: Official Google DeepMind social image for the AlphaProof Code post

items.title: Google adds Google Maps Platform inside Google AI Studio
items.summary: Google 喺 11 月 9 日宣布可以喺 Google AI Studio 內直接使用 Google Maps Platform，唔使離開工作區去設定帳單同憑證，並可以用提示建立即時互動預覽。官方指可以免費試用，亦唔一定要即時提供信用卡。
items.imageAlt: Official Google blog image for Maps Platform in AI Studio

items.title: OpenAI launches Business Hub and Business Agents in ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI 喺 11 月 10 日以測試版推出 ChatGPT 嘅 Businesses，企業可經 Business Hub 認領同核實機構、更新資料同睇匯總洞察；合資格美國電商同線上服務商可以建立 Business Agent，同用戶分開對話，亦可贊助並作為 ChatGPT Ads 目的地。官方指 ChatGPT 每週有 12 億用戶，並計劃逐步擴展至更多市場同類別。
items.note: Official post is dated November 10, 2026 without a clock time; used T00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: OpenAI social image for Business Agents in ChatGPT

items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Whiteboards and Sheets in beta, makes Claude Data generally available
items.summary: Anthropic 喺 11 月 10 日以測試版推出 Claude Whiteboards 同 Claude Sheets，並將原本嘅 Claude Dashboards 正式上線，改名 Claude Data；三項功能喺所有付費計劃嘅網頁、桌面同流動版都可用。Team 計劃預設開啟；Enterprise 計劃入面 Whiteboards 同 Sheets 預設關閉，Claude Data 會喺 11 月 19 日改為預設開啟。官方同日文章指 Claude Meetings 即將推出，未聲稱即日全面上線。
items.note: Official product post is dated November 10, 2026 without a clock time; used T00:00+08:00. Official articles say Claude Meetings is coming soon; press reports of a same-day Meetings beta were not used.
items.imageAlt: Open Graph image for Anthropic’s Claude Whiteboards, Sheets, and Data post

items.title: Adobe at MAX expands Creative Agent, previews local MCP integrations, and grows Firefly
items.summary: Adobe 喺 11 月 10 日邁阿密海灘嘅 MAX 大會宣布，擴大 Creative Cloud 同 Firefly 嘅 Creative Agent，並預覽本地 MCP 整合，讓第三方代理人可以直接改 Photoshop、Illustrator、Premiere 同 After Effects 專案檔，同時保持圖層同序列可編輯。Firefly 亦加入包括 ByteDance、Google、Kling、OpenAI 同 ElevenLabs 等合作夥伴模型，並推出 Firefly Video、Design 等新工具。
items.note: Adobe newsroom header shows Tuesday, November 10, 2026 9:00AM without a timezone; used T00:00+08:00. The same release restates the already-covered Disney Firefly alliance, which is not treated as new here.
items.imageAlt: Adobe newsroom image for the MAX 2026 creativity and agents announcement

items.title: Google introduces TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max, its fourth eighth-gen TPU systems this year
items.summary: Google 喺 11 月 9 日宣布 TPU 8tx 同 TPU 8i Max，令第八代 TPU 今年已有四款系統；官方指 TPU 而家有近 100 個外部客戶。8tx 主打安全同機密推論，聲稱延遲最多較 TPU 8t 低一倍；8i Max 將兩顆 TPU 8i 封入同一封裝，提供雙倍運算、SRAM 同 HBM 頻寬。
items.imageAlt: Official Google graphic of TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max systems

items.title: MiniMax open-weights H3-Image, a 33.1B 4K image generation and editing model
items.summary: MiniMax 開放權重發布 H3-Image，官方網誌指可喺 10 秒內生成 4K（4096×4096）圖像，並支援最多 16 張參考圖。Hugging Face 模型卡寫明約 331 億參數，採用 MiniMax-H3-Image Community License，並非標準 MIT 等 OSI 許可。
items.note: The blog’s visible date is 2026-11-11; JSON-LD datePublished is 2026-11-10T16:23:20.000Z, used here as publishedAt. Parameter count and license are from the official Hugging Face model card.
items.imageAlt: Cover image from MiniMax’s H3-Image announcement

items.title: Hugging Face adds a standard Decision Models interface in Transformers and llama.cpp
items.summary: Hugging Face 喺 11 月 10 日宣布為「決策模型」提供統一介面，輸入狀態同預設問題後會回傳帶機率嘅類型化決策，而唔係生成文字；Transformers 同 llama.cpp 都支援 /v1/systemone API。Hub 亦新增 decision-model 標籤；TRL 訓練支援仍標為即將推出。
items.note: Post is dated November 10, 2026; JSON-LD looks like a date-only midnight UTC placeholder. Exact clock time unknown; used T00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: Thumbnail from the Hugging Face Decision Models blog post

items.title: Hugging Face lets organizations pay for the Hub through Google Cloud Marketplace
items.summary: Hugging Face 喺 11 月 10 日宣布，機構可以將 Hub 用量經 Google Cloud Marketplace 掛到現有 Google Cloud 賬單，覆蓋 Team／Enterprise 升級同按用量計算資源。每筆 Marketplace 訂閱要先經 Hugging Face 審批，通過後先會改用 Google Cloud 結算。
items.note: Post is dated November 10, 2026; JSON-LD looks like a date-only midnight UTC placeholder. Exact clock time unknown; used T00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: Thumbnail from the Hugging Face Google Cloud Marketplace billing post

items.title: NVIDIA donates OpenShell to CNCF and opens new Kubernetes AI infrastructure tools
items.summary: NVIDIA 喺 11 月 10 日 KubeCon 宣布，將用於規管自主代理人嘅開源執行環境 OpenShell 捐贈予 CNCF，成為 Sandbox 項目，並開源預覽 NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine（NVKE）同 Kubernetes Recipes（NVKR），以及可唔使重新載入模型就還原檢查點嘅 NVIDIA Snapshot。合作夥伴 Crusoe 稱測試時工作負載就緒時間由約八分鐘降至 31 秒。
items.note: Official NVIDIA blog post is dated November 10, 2026 without a clock time; used T00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: NVIDIA blog key visual for its KubeCon open-source AI infrastructure announcements

items.title: HK Digital Policy Office pilots AI agents, aims to launch enterprise digital ID by year-end
items.summary: 署理數字政策專員張宜偉喺 11 月 10 日香港國際電腦會議表示，政府將於 2026 年底前推出「企業數碼身份」平台，數字辦正試行 AI 智能體，並會同香港人工智能研發院喺 2027 年發布社會安全管理指引。報道指「AI效能提升組」已推動 13 個部門共 30 項效能提升計劃。
items.note: Corroborated by Oriental Daily’s Nov 11 write-up of the same remarks. No matching info.gov.hk GIA was found for this speech.
items.imageAlt: Photo accompanying on.cc’s Nov 10 report on the Digital Policy Office AI-agent pilot

items.title: Lingnan University and Tsinghua sign MoU to advance AI+ education and research
items.summary: 嶺南大學喺 11 月 10 日同清華大學簽署校際合作備忘錄，清華常務副校長曾嶸率團訪嶺大，同校長秦泗釗簽署；雙方將深化師生交流、科研合作同人才培養，並探討「AI for Education」「AI for Materials」等合作。
items.note: Official press release is dated 10 Nov 2026 without a clock time; used T00:00+08:00. The signing is described as taking place that day.
items.imageAlt: Lingnan University and Tsinghua University representatives sign a cooperation memorandum

items.title: Lingnan and DI-IDEA plan a joint AI-education centre in the Northern Metropolis University Town
items.summary: 嶺南大學 11 月 10 日發布新聞稿，指校長秦泗釗於 11 月 6 至 7 日北京論壇期間，同數字智能國際發展教育聯盟（DI-IDEA）簽署備忘錄，雙方將探討設立聯合中心（暫名），並考慮適時落戶香港北部都會區大學城。DI-IDEA 由北京大學發起，嶺大為創始成員。
items.note: Official press release is dated 10 Nov 2026 without a clock time; used T00:00+08:00. The MoU was signed in Beijing on 6–7 Nov; included because the official Hong Kong announcement was posted on 10 Nov and was not in yesterday’s batch.
items.imageAlt: Lingnan President S. Joe Qin signs an MoU with DI-IDEA representatives

items.title: HKUST announces MoU with Unitree on embodied AI, a joint lab goal and Future AI Lab support
items.summary: 香港科技大學 11 月 9 日公布，已同宇樹科技簽署具身智能產學研合作備忘錄；簽署儀式其實喺 10 月 14 日舉行。合作將以科大計算機科學及工程學系同興建中嘅 Future AI Lab 為基礎，並朝聯合實驗室邁進，宇樹會提供雙臂、人形同四足等研究機械人平台。
items.note: University page article:published_time is 2026-11-09T03:30:40 with no timezone; treated as HKT. The ceremony was on 14 Oct 2026; included as an official announcement posted 9 Nov that was not in yesterday’s batch.
items.imageAlt: HKUST and Unitree representatives at the embodied AI MoU signing

items.title: OpenAI acquires AI travel startup Odessia; founder Francis Davidson joins
items.summary: TechCrunch 報道 OpenAI 收購由 Sonder 創辦人 Francis Davidson 成立嘅 AI 旅遊初創 Odessia，條款未披露；Davidson 表示自己而家喺 OpenAI 做旅遊相關工作，OpenAI 發言人亦向 TechCrunch 確認聘用。報道指呢間成立約一年嘅公司先前由 Sequoia 領投籌得 600 萬美元，其旅遊工具已經關閉。
items.note: imageUrl is null because the TechCrunch og:image is a Getty Images stock photo. Deal terms were not disclosed.

items.title: New York opens RAISE Act registration portal for large frontier AI developers
items.summary: TechCrunch 報道紐約州已開放 RAISE 法案登記入口，年收入超過 5 億美元嘅大型前沿開發者須喺 2027 年 1 月 1 日前登記；法案將於 2027 年初生效，要求公開安全框架、72 小時內呈報重大安全事故，以及發布模型透明度報告。新成立嘅 DIGIT 辦公室負責執行，單次違規罰款最高可達 100 萬美元，其後最高 300 萬美元。
items.note: imageUrl is null because the TechCrunch og:image is a Getty/Bloomberg stock photo. This item is based on TechCrunch’s report of the state’s announcement, not a fetched New York government press release.

items.title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625 million
items.summary: TechCrunch 報道 Oura 宣布將以 6.25 億美元收購 AI 原生初級醫療公司 Counsel Health；Counsel 服務已於 6 月接入 Oura app，交易預計喺 2027 年底前完成。成交後 Counsel 會繼續服務現有同新企業夥伴。
items.note: imageUrl is null because the TechCrunch og:image is a Getty stock photo.

items.title: Path Robotics raises $300 million Series E at a $2.45 billion valuation
items.summary: Path Robotics 宣布完成 3 億美元 E 輪融資，投後估值 24.5 億美元，由 Georgian 領投，資金將用於擴大焊接業務同其他製造任務。公司指過去 18 個月經常性年收入增長 17 倍，今年早前亦宣布同 HII 簽訂價值 6 億美元、以表現為基礎嘅美國海軍造船生產協議。
items.note: Clock time 9:05 AM EST on November 10, 2026 comes from a Business Wire syndication stamp on a full reprint of the same release. imageUrl is null because the Business Wire media image could not be downloaded.

items.title: Mercor raises $750 million Series D at a $20 billion valuation
items.summary: Mercor 喺 11 月 10 日宣布完成 7.5 億美元 D 輪融資，估值 200 億美元，投資者包括 Benchmark、General Catalyst、NVIDIA、Salesforce 同 Zoom 等。公司為企業提供專家網絡、評估同訓練基礎設施，聲稱網絡有超過 500 萬名專家，今年亦已收購 Deeptune。
items.imageAlt: Cover image from Mercor’s official Series D blog post

items.title: Anthropic launches IPO roadshow for 825 million Class A shares at $70–$78
items.summary: Anthropic 喺 11 月 10 日啟動擬議首次公開發售路演，計劃發行 8.25 億股 A 類普通股，預期發行價每股 70 至 78 美元，並申請以代號 ANT 喺納斯達克上市。其中約 8.0135 億股由公司發售，約 2,365 萬股由現有股東出售，公司唔會從後者獲得所得款；註冊聲明尚未生效，官方帖文亦無公布估值。
items.note: Official post is dated November 10, 2026; article:published_time appears to be a date-only timestamp. Exact clock time unknown; used T00:00+08:00. Press-reported implied valuations are not on the official page and are not included.
items.imageAlt: Anthropic newsroom Open Graph image for the IPO roadshow announcement

items.title: NVDA closes Nov 10 at $168.89 (−5.47%) as CEO probe headlines linger
items.summary: Nvidia（NVDA）喺 11 月 10 日（周二）收市報 $168.89，跌 $9.78 或 5.47%。Motley Fool 收市後回顧指股價延續兩日跌勢，背景係董事會獨立調查行政總裁黃仁勳，公司將於 11 月 17 日公布業績；同一篇報道指標普 500 跌 0.38% 至 7,521，納斯達克綜合指數跌 0.74% 至 25,066。
items.note: Close confirmed on Yahoo Finance (At close: 4:00:01 PM EST). Fool’s narrative text said $168.80 / −5.52%, but Yahoo’s at-close quote and Fool’s widget both show $168.89 / −5.47%; the latter was used. CNBC rounded the drop to 5.5%.
items.imageAlt: Hero image from Motley Fool’s Nov 10 U.S. stock market recap

items.title: AMD closes Nov 10 at $515.21 (+1.30%) as chip peers diverge from Nvidia
items.summary: AMD 喺 11 月 10 日收市報 $515.21，升 $6.63 或 1.30%。Motley Fool 收市後回顧將呢次升幅同 Nvidia 下跌對比，指分歧較似反映 Nvidia 自身消息，多過整個 AI 晶片需求被重新評估。
items.note: Exact close also confirmed on Yahoo Finance ($515.21, +1.30%, at close 4:00:01 PM EST).
items.imageAlt: Hero image from Motley Fool’s Nov 10 U.S. stock market recap

items.title: AVGO closes Nov 10 at $331.98 (+3.91%) even as Nvidia slides
items.summary: Broadcom（AVGO）喺 11 月 10 日收市報 $331.98，升 $12.50 或 3.91%。Motley Fool 收市後回顧將 Broadcom 同 AMD 一併視為當日表現較 Nvidia 好嘅半導體同業。
items.note: Exact close also confirmed on Yahoo Finance ($331.98, +3.91%, at close 4:00:01 PM EST).
items.imageAlt: Hero image from Motley Fool’s Nov 10 U.S. stock market recap

items.title: MSFT closes Nov 10 at $533.16 (−2.20%)
items.summary: Microsoft（MSFT）喺 11 月 10 日收市報 $533.16，跌 $12.02 或 2.20%，上一交易日收市為 $545.18。Yahoo Finance 列當日開市 $543.41，區間約 $526.36 至 $544.15，成交量約 2,690 萬股。
items.note: Yahoo’s quote page has no suitable article hero/og image, so imageUrl is null. After-hours prints are not used.

items.title: Prinny Party: Going Overboard! listed to launch November 11 in the west
items.summary: NIS America 早前宣布派對 RPG《Prinny Party: Going Overboard!》將於 11 月 11 日喺西方數位推出，平台包括 PS5、Switch 2、Switch 同 Steam。日本同亞洲則訂喺 11 月 12 日推出，當地會有實體同數位版；遊戲支援 Switch 2 GameShare 同 Steam Remote Play Together。
items.note: Western digital launch is scheduled for November 11; Japan/Asia is November 12. At the HKT-morning fetch on November 11 this had not been independently confirmed as live. Source article is Gematsu’s September date announcement. publishedAt is the scheduled western date (date-only), not the original announcement timestamp. No usable og:image (Gematsu page was bot-blocked on refetch).

items.title: Euro Truck Simulator 2: Iceland DLC is out now on Steam
items.summary: SCS Software 宣布《Euro Truck Simulator 2》冰島地圖擴充已喺 Steam 推出，包括 14 個城市同聚落、環島公路，以及瀑布、火山地形同極光等景觀。同步開跑 World of Trucks「Cruising Iceland」活動，完成個人同社群目標可獲塗裝等獎勵。
items.note: Official SCS blog post stamped 11/10/2026 10:00:00 AM with no timezone. publishedAt converts 10:00 to HKT assuming Central European Time (SCS is based in Prague). Confirms yesterday’s listed Steam date.
items.imageAlt: Euro Truck Simulator 2 Iceland DLC promotional image

items.title: Football Manager 27 is live across PC, consoles, Apple Arcade and Netflix
items.summary: Sports Interactive／SEGA 宣布《Football Manager 27》已喺 PC／Mac（Steam、Epic、Microsoft Store）、PS5、Xbox，以及 Xbox Game Pass／PC Game Pass 上線，Launch Preview 存檔可以繼續用。FM27 Touch 經 Apple Arcade、FM27 Mobile 則經 Netflix 推出；官方提醒部分球會同球員資料仍待授權、可能暫時缺席。
items.note: Official Football Manager post dated 10.11.26. Date-only publishedAt; the post notes different platforms may go live at different times.
items.imageAlt: Football Manager 27 official launch artwork

items.title: DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered is out now on PC, Switch 2 and consoles
items.summary: Aspyr 同 Universal 宣布《DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered》已數位上架 PS5、Xbox Series、Switch 2、Switch，同埋 Steam、Steam Deck 同 Epic Games Store。重製加咗改良畫面、最多四人線上／客廳合作、相片模式等；實體 Standard、Deluxe 同 Collector 版即日起預購，預計 2027 年春季至秋季出貨。
items.note: Official Aspyr / Universal Games Press release dated Nov. 10, 2026, Austin. Confirms yesterday’s listed Steam/console date. Date-only publishedAt. Physical editions: Standard ships Spring 2027; Deluxe and Collector’s ship Fall 2027. No usable public og:image on the Games Press page.

items.title: Ashes of the Singularity II is available now on PC
items.summary: Stardock 宣布大規模 RTS 續作《Ashes of the Singularity II》現已推出，可指揮地球聯合部隊、後人類聯盟或 AI Substrate，支援單人戰役、遭遇戰同合作／競技多人。遊戲喺 Steam 同 Stardock 直銷上架，發布時有截至 11 月 17 日嘅 20% 上市折扣。
items.note: Official Stardock post dated Tuesday, November 10, 2026. Confirms yesterday’s listed Steam date. Date-only publishedAt.
items.imageAlt: Ashes of the Singularity II official launch artwork

items.title: Stormforge enters Steam Early Access
items.summary: Roboto Games 宣布開放世界生存建造遊戲《Stormforge》已喺 Steam 開搶先體驗，玩家要喺會追人嘅龍捲風同混沌風暴入面生存，最多可 8 人遊玩。搶先體驗含三個生態、三個首領同五個職業，並由即日起支援 Steam Workshop 模組。
items.note: Official Roboto Games Games Press release dated November 10th, 2026. Confirms yesterday’s listed Early Access date. Date-only publishedAt. Games Press og:image used a signed CDN URL, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: Ova Magica is out now on Switch 2 and other consoles
items.summary: Top Hat Studios 宣布農場養成兼生物收集遊戲《Ova Magica》已登陸 Switch、Switch 2、PS5 同 Xbox 系列主機，同原有 Steam／GOG 版並列。玩家喺 Clover Town 耕田、培育 blob 同伴，兼且可以探索同參加 Clover Cup。
items.note: Official Top Hat Studios Games Press release dated 10/11/2026. Confirms yesterday’s listed console date (previously marked uncertain). Date-only publishedAt. Games Press og:image used a signed CDN URL, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: TANUKI: Pon's Summer is out now on PC, Switch 2 and consoles
items.summary: CRITICAL REFLEX／Denkiworks 宣布開放世界冒險《TANUKI: Pon’s Summer》已喺 Steam、Switch、Switch 2、PS5、PS4 同 Xbox 推出，並加入 Xbox Game Pass。玩家扮演狸貓郵差 Pon，踩 BMX 送郵同修復神社；Switch 同 Switch 2 版可免費互相升級。
items.note: Official CRITICAL REFLEX Games Press release dated Nov. 10, 2026, Kyoto. Confirms yesterday’s listed date. Date-only publishedAt. No usable public og:image on the Games Press page.

items.title: Warhammer Survivors is out now on PC, Switch 2 and consoles
items.summary: Auroch Digital 宣布官方彈幕生存遊戲《Warhammer Survivors》已登陸 Steam、GOG、Switch、Switch 2、PS5、Xbox Series 同手機，並於 Xbox Game Pass 首日加入。遊戲由 Boltgun 團隊聯同 Vampire Survivors 的 poncle 合作，有超過 40 個可玩角色；PC 版已通過 Steam Deck Verified。
items.note: Official Auroch Digital Games Press release dated 10th November 2026, Bristol. Confirms yesterday’s listed date. Date-only publishedAt. No usable public og:image on the Games Press page.

items.title: Mouse Work is dated for December 7 on Switch 2
items.summary: Nitrome 宣布專門使用 Joy-Con 2 滑鼠操作嘅派對遊戲《Mouse Work》將於 12 月 7 日登陸 Switch 2。遊戲有約十小時以上單人戰役，亦支援 1 至 4 人本地同線上 GameShare 合作，共 54 份工作、18 種職業。
items.note: Gematsu timestamp Nov 10 2026 / 1:29 PM EST converted to HKT. Also reported by Nintendo Life on November 10.

items.title: TMNT: Splintered Fate Shell Squad Co-Op update is out now
items.summary: Super Evil Megacorp 已為《Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate》推出免費「Shell Squad Co-Op Update」，加入新嘅合作技能、工具同角色精通，並改善線上／沙發合作換角。同步推出「Trench Coat Pack」DLC；遊戲已喺 PS5、Xbox、Switch 2、Switch 同 PC 推出。
items.note: Gematsu timestamp Nov 10 2026 / 11:00 AM EST converted to HKT. Also reported by Nintendo Life on November 10.

items.title: Nintendo says Ocarina of Time is “off to a great start,” without giving figures
items.summary: 任天堂公布最新財報問答譯文，社長古川俊治表示《Zelda: Ocarina of Time》Switch 2 重製「開局理想」，但現階段提供具體數字仍過早。佢又提到 Zelda 40 周年主機帶動多區硬件銷售，並維持本財年 1,600 萬部主機銷量預測。
items.note: Nintendo Life article posted 10:45am on 10 Nov 2026 (interpreted as UK GMT → 18:45 HKT), citing nintendo.co.jp Q&A translation. No unit sales for the game were provided. The 16 million hardware forecast is Nintendo’s existing fiscal-year outlook, not a new figure. UK physical-chart result was already in the Nov 10 batch.

items.title: Big Walk developer House House discloses limited LLM use in late development
items.summary: Untitled Goose Game 團隊 House House 發聲明，指喺《Big Walk》開發後期曾少量使用 LLM 幫手處理技術難題同 bug，估計少於 0.1% 程式碼與此有關，並無用於其他創作。團隊強調呢次並非為 AI 工具背書，承認當時未有內部政策是失職，並會制訂更完整規範。
items.note: Nintendo Life article posted 8:55am on 10 Nov 2026 (interpreted as UK GMT → 16:55 HKT), quoting House House’s FAQ statement. Disclosure followed a voluntary IGF Awards submission after some jurors said they would not vote for games that use generative AI.

items.title: Super Mario Party Jamboree update 2.4.0 adds GameShare via GameChat on Switch 2
items.summary: 任天堂為《Super Mario Party Jamboree》推出 2.4.0 更新。Switch 2 版而家可以喺 GameShare 選「Friends via GameChat」，並為 GameShare 加咗地圖同規則選項；Switch 同 Switch 2 都有一般問題修正。官方補丁說明標示更新於 11 月 9 日推出。
items.note: Nintendo Life article posted 2:05am on 10 Nov 2026 (interpreted as UK GMT → 10:05 HKT). Official notes quoted in the article say Ver. 2.4.0 was released November 9, 2026. No usable og:image (Nintendo Life was bot-blocked on refetch).

items.title: Switch 2 system update 23.5.0 is live, adding support for eShop gifting on November 17
items.summary: 任天堂已推出 Switch 2 同 Switch 系統更新 23.5.0。最顯著係加入即將到來嘅 eShop 贈禮功能支援，預計喺 11 月 17 日 eShop 更新後，可以向 Nintendo Account 家庭群組成員送遊戲。Switch 2 版仲可以喺初次設定調整無障礙選項，並為 Text to Speech 同 GameChat 新增葡萄牙（葡萄牙）語。
items.note: Official patch notes quoted by Nintendo Life say Ver. 23.5.0 was released November 9, 2026. Nintendo Life article posted 1:30am on 10 Nov 2026 (interpreted as UK GMT → 09:30 HKT). eShop gifting itself is scheduled for November 17, not live with the firmware. Nintendo Life also says the update has supposedly patched a recent jailbreak; that claim is not in the official notes and is omitted here.
items.imageAlt: Nintendo Switch 2 system update 23.5.0

items.title: Bungie teases Marathon’s Symbiosis update for December 8, including a co-op PvE roguelite mode
items.summary: Bungie 公布《Marathon》Symbiosis 更新預告，將於 12 月 8 日推出，新增名為 Expedition 嘅常設合作 PvE roguelite 模式、社交空間 Limbo，以及 Team Deathmatch 測試。更新當日會有一週免費遊玩，之後買斷進度同物品可以保留。
items.note: PC Gamer article dated 10 November 2026 with no time stamp; date-only publishedAt. Bungie called Expedition “phase one” of its PvE plan; many mode details remain unrevealed.
items.imageAlt: Marathon Symbiosis gameplay image from PC Gamer

items.title: Fangamer’s Hollow Knight and Silksong Switch 2 physical editions are available
items.summary: Nintendo Life 收到 Fangamer 送來嘅《Hollow Knight》同《Silksong》Switch 2 實體版，盒內有說明書同蠟印信封裝嘅地圖，封面仲有可翻轉護套。初代所有 DLC 已入卡帶；《Silksong》嘅 Sea of Sorrow 擴充未入卡，之後會以免費下載提供。兩款而家可喺 Fangamer 網站購買。
items.note: Nintendo Life gallery listed under 10 Nov 2026; date-only publishedAt because the page used a relative “5 hours ago” stamp. Sea of Sorrow has no firm release date in the article. Physical photos are Nintendo Life’s own; no separate public og:image was captured.

items.title: Sony cancels Fairgame$, with no layoffs at Haven Interactive Studios
items.summary: 據 Bloomberg 同 Sony 內部電郵，Sony 已取消 Haven Interactive Studios 嘅多人射擊作《Fairgame$》。高層指最近有數千人參與嘅 playtest 留存同玩家反饋未達目標，再加 PvP 射擊市場環境困難。Sony 向 Bloomberg 表示唔會裁員，Haven 會轉去支援社內其他工作室；遊戲原計劃登陸 PS5 同 PC。
items.note: Gematsu timestamp Nov 10 2026 / 3:58 PM EST converted to HKT, citing Bloomberg and an employee email reviewed by Bloomberg. Also reported by The Verge and PC Gamer.
items.imageAlt: Fairgame$ cancellation report image from Gematsu

items.title: PlayStation Plus November catalog adds Death Stranding 2, Dragon Quest III and more
items.summary: PlayStation 公布 11 月 Plus Extra／Premium 目錄，包括《Death Stranding 2: On the Beach》、《Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake》、《Atomfall》等，多數地區 11 月 17 日上架。《Hell Let Loose》會喺 11 月 11 日於美英、12 日於日本先行提供；Premium 則加入《Soul Reaver 2》同《Freedom Wars Remastered》。
items.note: Official PlayStation.Blog post dated November 10, 2026, with no time on the page. publishedAt uses Gematsu’s matching report timestamp of Nov 10 2026 / 11:40 AM EST converted to HKT. Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii is Nov 24 in the US, UK and Japan; Trepang2, MotoGP 26 and Cricket 26 are Nov 24 in the US and UK. This is the official full lineup, expanding on the earlier Japan-blog mention in the Nov 10 batch.
items.imageAlt: PlayStation Plus November 2026 Game Catalog artwork

items.title: Sony and Xbox say GTA 6 is the most pre-ordered game in their store histories
items.summary: PlayStation Blog 宣布《GTA VI》已成為 PlayStation Store 史上預購最多嘅遊戲，並因此提前九日開放 PS5 預載，採各國午夜滾動解禁。PC Gamer 引述 Xbox 同樣稱佢係 Microsoft Store 史上預購最多嘅作品，並指 Series 主機以外，亦可以經雲端喺 Xbox One 遊玩，但唔會喺 PC 上串流。
items.note: PC Gamer article dated 10 November 2026 with no time stamp; date-only publishedAt. Official PlayStation.Blog post: https://blog.playstation.com/2026/11/10/pre-load-grand-theft-auto-vi-on-ps5-starting-today/ — no raw pre-order unit numbers were published. Yesterday’s batch already covered preloading itself; the new element is the official “most pre-ordered” store claims. Image omitted because the PC Gamer og:image was not separately captured for this URL.

items.title: Hard West 2 is out now on PS5 and Xbox Series
items.summary: 在 PC 推出之後，Ice Code Games、Good Shepherd 同 Klabater 宣布邪典西部回合制策略遊戲《Hard West 2》已登陸 PS5 同 Xbox Series。玩家要帶領亡命之徒奪回靈魂，戰鬥結合卡牌超自然能力同 Bravado 狀態。
items.note: Official Games Press release dated 11/10/2026. Date-only publishedAt. The game was already out on PC. No usable public og:image on the Games Press page.

items.title: Rockstar and PlayStation announce GTA VI Festival in Miami on November 21
items.summary: Rockstar 同 PlayStation 宣布 11 月 21 日喺邁阿密 Mana Wynwood 舉辦一日音樂節「Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival」，陣容包括 Travis Scott、Cardi B、Metro Boomin，以及為遊戲配樂嘅 Justice DJ set。門票抽籤 11 月 10 日截止，中籤者可喺 11 月 11 日中午（美東）起最多買兩張票，入場須年滿 17 歲。
items.note: Consequence article dated November 9, 2026, 10:45am ET, converted to HKT. Official event site: https://gtavi-thefestival.miami/. Also covered by Rolling Stone and USA Today on November 9. Not in the Nov 10 morning batch. Lottery operated by Laylo; a code does not guarantee tickets.
items.imageAlt: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival announcement poster

items.title: Sony will retire the PlayStation Plus PC app on December 10
items.summary: Sony 宣布將於 12 月 10 日停用 Windows PC 版 PlayStation Plus 雲端串流應用程式，理由係合資格 Premium 會員使用率不足 0.4%。呢次唔影響 PS5／PS4 主機上嘅 Plus 會籍同福利，受影響用戶會收到通知；主機同 PlayStation Portal 串流仍然可用。
items.note: The Verge timestamp Nov 10, 2026, 7:40 PM UTC converted to HKT. The same notice appears in Sony’s official November PlayStation Plus catalog blog post. Portal/console streaming remaining available is stated by The Verge.
items.imageAlt: PlayStation Plus logo

items.title: Bandai Namco to shut down Reflector Entertainment
items.summary: Bandai Namco 宣布解散並清算蒙特利爾工作室 Reflector Entertainment，即《Unknown 9: Awakening》開發商。公司稱綜合考慮未來計劃、額外投資同盈利可能後決定停業，具體清算時間表未定，並預期喺截至 2027 年 3 月 31 日財年第三季起計入約 2,100 萬歐元特別損失。
items.note: Gematsu timestamp Nov 9 2026 / 11:55 PM EST converted to HKT, after the Nov 10 morning batch. The €21 million extraordinary-loss figure is from Bandai Namco’s announcement as reported by Gematsu. Official notice: https://www.bandainamco.co.jp/files/E_HP_Clean__E980A3E7B590E5AD90E4BC9AE7A4BEE381AEE8.pdf
items.imageAlt: Bandai Namco Reflector Entertainment closure report image
